title: Custom Trucking Semi Truck on Metallic Mesh Background Comforter
description:
Transform your bedroom with this custom-themed bedding set from Jeminise. Featuring a bold graphic design of a semi truck on a metallic mesh background, this comforter set is tailored for truckers and truck enthusiasts who live life like a legend. Personalization options allow you to customize the set with your own name, making it a unique addition to your home or a thoughtful gift for family and friends.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Features a custom text input field where you can add your name directly onto the design.
  • Soft & Cozy Feel: Made from 100% brushed polyester fabric with whole-piece microfiber filling to prevent clumping and shifting.
  • Available Sizes: Offered in Twin (68" x 88"), Full (78" x 88"), Queen (88" x 88"), and King (104" x 88") sizes.
  • Included Components: Comes as a comforter set with optional matching pillowcases and flat sheets to suit your needs.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water, separates easily, and air dries quickly without heat to remain soft and fluffy.
